correctness.rationale: The field structure follows from 3^20=-1 mod 41; four power tests establish coefficient order 1680. The q-Frobenius orbit alpha+j32u has exactly 41 elements, proving irreducibility. 83 divides 41^82−1, and exact modular exponentiation Z^((41^82−1)/83) mod G equals 1. Two independently written, standalone standard-library implementations over different quotient rings confirm the critical finite identity. This proves a proper multiplicative order and respects all quantifiers and boundary conditions.
